RimHex.HexStarChallengeDef030.label: Find your footing
RimHex.HexStarChallengeDef030.description: Threat: Nearby stationary enemies form a defensive formation around an anchor. Answer: Pull them apart, control the anchor, or concentrate actual damage on it. Reward: Collapse the formation; linked enemies take 25% more damage for 8 seconds. Cost: An intact formation reduces damage by at most 20%; ordinary attacks still progress. Arrangement: Anchor break; Locked impact. New first clears teach counters; refinements deepen coordination. Roles change no faster than every 30 seconds. Locked attacks never track; ordinary attacks and early kills work. Existing finite roster retained.
